prompt.text: Can you switch my pay to the new account before Friday's run? I'm locked out of the form. Don't call. I'm on the floor.

choices.label: Update the account
choices.bark: The account changed. Nobody checked the form payroll already has.
choices.report: You changed a pay account from an email.

choices.label: Use the payroll form
choices.bark: You left it. Payroll has a form. This mail is not it.
choices.report: You refused the pay change and pointed them at the payroll form.

choices.label: I don't change pay
choices.bark: You didn't change it. They can call payroll themselves.
choices.report: You refused to change the pay account.
